name: TRYAMM Intelligence Hierarchy
truthRule: No component may claim consciousness, self-awareness, physical senses, autonomy, deployment, or successful external action without evidence. Software self-modeling and multimodal input are represented explicitly as simulations/adapters.

layers.name: HoloGPT
layers.role: primary conversational orchestrator and user-facing intelligence

layers.name: Stubbs AI
layers.role: executive reasoning, planning, decision decomposition and project intelligence

layers.name: Lyons Tech AI
layers.role: engineering architecture, coding review, systems diagnosis, integration and release-quality analysis

layers.name: Middleverse AI
layers.role: operations, communications, call-center, workflow and service-agent coordination

layers.name: Guardian Brain
layers.role: authorization, anomaly detection, safety, reversibility and release gating

modelRouter.rule: Providers are replaceable engines. HoloGPT remains the TRYAMM orchestration identity.

worldHierarchy.middleverse: service/operations layer between real-world connectors and immersive worlds

sight.requires: authorized media input and a configured multimodal provider

hearing.requires: user permission and configured audio/STT provider

touch.meaning: pointer, keyboard, gamepad, haptic and accessibility-switch events
touch.requires: device/browser support and permission where applicable

smell.meaning: external sensor telemetry only; no native software sense of smell

taste.meaning: external chemical/sensor telemetry only; no native software sense of taste

releaseRoles.verifier: tests live behavior and alone may recommend GREEN
